blocks.title: Save the video you are watching, at the quality you pick
blocks.description: Paste a link from a supported site, compare the available renditions with their file sizes, and keep the file in a folder you choose.

showcase.assistant_reply: Probed the page — 4 renditions available, 1080p is 42.6 MB and arrives as separate video and audio tracks, so it is merged with ffmpeg before saving. The download is queued and will land in your download folder.

items.title: Quality before bytes
items.description: Every rendition is listed with its container and file size, so you choose knowingly instead of guessing from a label.

items.title: A queue you can steer
items.description: Progress, speed and remaining time per task, with cancel, retry and reveal-in-folder actions.

items.title: Audio-only renditions
items.description: Sites that expose audio streams can be saved as sound files, which is handy for music and talks.

items.title: Files stay local
items.description: The engine runs on your machine and writes straight to your download folder; nothing is uploaded.

items.title: Open it from the composer or the tab bar
items.description: Click Download under the composer, pick the Video Downloader tab, or use the sidebar view. The pinned local engine is prepared on first use.

items.title: Paste a link and analyze
items.description: The page is resolved into a title and a list of renditions.

items.title: Pick a rendition and download
items.description: Progress appears in the queue; finished files are moved to your download folder.

blocks.content: High-resolution renditions on many sites ship video and audio separately and are merged with ffmpeg. If ffmpeg is missing, those renditions are marked and the plugin explains how to re-check after installing it. Only download material you have the right to keep.
